description: This source file defines the class 'XForm' which represents a graphical object used for rendering retained graphics in the PDFsharp library. It encompasses constructors for various initialization scenarios, state management methods like 'DrawingFinished', and resource management features specific to PDF forms and templates. It also contains properties for view box, size, transformation matrix, and resource handling, tailored for both GDI+ and WPF contexts.

classes.name: XForm
classes.description: Represents a graphical object used to render retained graphics on it, functioning as a form in GDI+, WPF, and PDF contexts. Supports creation from various sources such as PDF pages, template forms, and graphics context, managing state throughout drawing and finalization.

methods.name: DrawingFinished
methods.description: Marks the form as finished, finalizing the drawing operations and disposing of associated graphics contexts.

methods.name: AssociateGraphics
methods.description: Associates an XGraphics object with the form to enable drawing operations.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Sets the form's state to 'Finished', closing resources and preparing it for rendering.

methods.name: GetFontName
methods.description: Retrieves the resource name for a specified font type and typeface within this form.

methods.name: TryGetFontName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the resource name of a font by id; returns null if not found.

methods.name: GetFontName
methods.description: Retrieves the resource name for a font given its id, font data, and font object.

methods.name: GetImageName
methods.description: Retrieves the resource name for an image within this form.

methods.name: GetFormName
methods.description: Retrieves the resource name for a nested form within this form.
